owner: Dr Hamed Dadjou and the team
summary: A named lead dentist and a central Bloor location are strengths, but conflicting addresses and an empty benefits section appear to cost you new patients.

findings.problem: The address appears three ways: 2 Bloor Street West Suite 1904 in the header, 2 Bloor St E Unit 1904 in the clinic section, and 2 Bloor St W #1904 in the footer.
findings.cost: Patients and maps get sent to the wrong side of the street.
findings.fix: One verified address with a map.

findings.problem: The Patient Benefits section promises options but appears to list none, and the Forms and Sedation Dentistry menu items appear to link to #.
findings.cost: Empty sections and dead links make the practice look unfinished.

findings.problem: What Our Patients Say About Us appears twice with the same two reviews, only three reviews appear with no dates, and the Facebook link appears to go to a login page.
findings.cost: Thin, repeated proof does little to win a new patient.
findings.fix: Dated Google reviews and a working Facebook page.

findings.problem: Booking buttons are worded four ways (Book Online, Book an Appointment, Book Appointment, Book Your Appointment) and the page shows no WhatsApp or online chat.
findings.cost: Mixed calls to action and no quick channel lose patients on mobile.
findings.fix: One clear booking button with WhatsApp.

redesign: One address, one clear booking button.
